coords: exact complete integer arrays, including row order

latents.comparison_precision: float64 after preserving original stored values

mesh.chamfer: 0.5*(mean nearest-neighbor Euclidean distance actual->reference + mean nearest-neighbor Euclidean distance reference->actual), complete vertex sets without sampling
mesh.object_scale: Euclidean diagonal of reference mesh axis-aligned bounding box

nonfinite: reject all nonfinite values; no filtering
empty: reject empty geometry or latent arrays
reference_identity: canonical source/checkpoint/runtime/input/options plus all artifact hashes must authenticate before comparison
